releaseNotes: NEW — HONEST COMPATIBILITY SYSTEM: the 'Popular' section is now SUPPORTED — only apps we have verified to run perfectly as clones (Discord, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, Snapchat, X, Reddit, Signal, Threads, Spotify). No more pretending: games like Free Fire, BGMI, PUBG, Roblox, Supercell and Genshin are now marked NOT SUPPORTED, because their anti-cheat verifies the APK signature and crashes cloned builds (real-world tested — that's why your FF clone crashed).

Every game Android declares as a game gets the same protection automatically, and Google-only sign-in apps (YouTube, Gmail, Maps, Photos) are blocked too — their login refuses clone signatures, so cloning them is a waste of time.
Tapping a NOT SUPPORTED app now explains exactly WHY it can't be cloned instead of doing nothing — no more silent dead ends.
Everything else in ALL APPS that we haven't verified now shows an 'untested' badge and asks for a one-tap confirmation before cloning, with a clear heads-up that security-hardened apps may crash.
The badge under app tiles now reads 'supported' / 'untested' / 'not supported' — exactly what it is.
